Saudi Airport Attacked Amid West Asia Tensions, Flights Cancelled

Multiple airports in Saudi Arabia, including in the capital and Sanaa, have been attacked amid escalating West Asia tensions. Houthi-aligned media reported strikes on Sanaa International Airport, with Houthi spokesperson warning against further actions. The Saudi-led coalition condemned an earlier attack that resulted in civilian casualties and fatalities of various nationalities. Saudi Arabia has vowed a major response after one strike on an airport reportedly killed 12 people and injured 309. The geopolitical situation has led to the cancellation of several flights between Kochi in Kerala and destinations in Saudi Arabia for October 11 to 13, according to Cochin International Airport Limited. The Australian government has also issued a warning against flying to the Saudi capital following three airport attacks.
